record.hypothesis: Across all four categories, untie history and target/candidate embedding tables, unit-normalizing both and initializing them identically (embedding). Replace the pairwise term with softplus(0.5+negative-positive), retaining the 0.2 pointwise term (objective). Set LR=0.0007 and dropout=0.15 (hyperparameters). Separate input/output roles may reduce conflicting gradients; the ranking margin encourages separation, while slower updates and stronger dropout constrain the added parameters. Preserve GRU topology, history and sampling.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four categories, couple a smaller learning rate with stronger dropout to regularize the added embedding parameters while preserving GRU topology and training limits.
Add a 0.5 ranking margin to encourage positive-negative separation while retaining the incumbent 0.2 pointwise coefficient and nonpadding averaging.

Untie history and output embeddings, retaining unit normalization and identical initial weights. Separate input and prediction roles may reduce gradient conflict. Both tables belong to one jointly trained GRU model per category. The embedded predictor already imports GRU4RecModel from train.py and strictly loads its complete state dictionary, so it automatically restores both tables without writer changes.
